expectation: Intestinal fibroblast and macrophage subsets co-localize.
limitation: Human IBD evidence concerns specific subsets; these atlas labels are broader.

expectation: Muscularis macrophages associate with enteric neurons.
signaling: Macrophage BMP2 acts on neurons; neuronal CSF1 supports macrophages.
spatial_direction: Reciprocal signaling does not imply equal spatial conditional rates.
limitation: Mechanistic mouse evidence; not every atlas macrophage is a muscularis macrophage.

expectation: Subepithelial mesenchymal cells form an epithelial stem-cell niche.
signaling: Mesenchymal Wnt supports epithelial stem-cell renewal.
spatial_direction: No predicted stronger rule direction with these broad labels.
limitation: Mouse GLI1-positive mesenchyme and stem cells are not separately resolved here.

expectation: Paneth cells contact epithelial stem cells in small-intestinal crypts.
signaling: Paneth cells provide Wnt, EGF and Notch niche signals to stem cells.
spatial_direction: Paneth-centered epithelial proximity may be higher because Paneth cells occupy a restricted epithelial niche; this is an anatomical inference, not a published rule inequality.
limitation: The Epithelial label includes more than LGR5-positive stem cells; mouse evidence.

expectation: Mucosal plasma cells occupy APRIL-rich survival niches near epithelial structures.
signaling: APRIL supports plasma-cell survival; its cellular source differs by intestinal location.
limitation: The study found no small-intestinal epithelial APRIL production; neutrophils supplied APRIL there. Proximity cannot identify the producer.

expectation: Vascular smooth muscle and endothelial cells form adjacent vessel-wall compartments.
signaling: Endothelial PDGF-B recruits/supports PDGFR-beta-positive mural cells during development.
spatial_direction: No predicted stronger rule direction across a mixture of vessel sizes.
limitation: Mouse vascular-development evidence; adult gut proximity cannot validate developmental signaling.
